response.rationale: “Garansi” is the ordinary Indonesian term, while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “jaminan” for a seller or manufacturer’s product-defect coverage. Both match the same warranty sense.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian usage varies between “jaminan” and “waranti,” especially by register or product context.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Waranti” is also a plausible Malaysian alternative, but “jaminan” remains a useful ordinary Malaysian preference; “garansi” is the clearer Indonesian default.
